class.name: com.microsdsqlite.MicroSDSQLite
class.comment: Manages SQLite databases on removable external storage. SAF tree URIs are not normal filesystem paths and cannot be opened directly by Android SQLite. Use the removable app-specific external directory for no-permission direct access, use an arbitrary direct path only after Android grants Manage All Files access and the real database file opens successfully, or use experimental SAF file-descriptor mode when a direct path is unavailable. A saved SAF tree URI can be reused, and SAF databases can be opened directly in that folder or at a relative path under it. SAF file-descriptor mode keeps the real .db file on the card, disables WAL assumptions, and uses conservative connection PRAGMAs; document-provider sidecar behavior can vary.
class.event: SafFolderSelected (Success As Boolean, FolderUri As String)
Error (Operation As String, Message As String)

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initializes the manager and sets the event name.

method.name: IsInitialized
method.comment: Returns true after Initialize has been called.

method.name: GetExternalFilesDirs
method.comment: Returns the app-specific external file directories exposed by Android. One of these may be on the removable microSD card.

method.name: GetExternalFilesDirInfo
method.comment: Returns a human-readable list of app-specific external file directories, including removable state and usable bytes.

method.name: GetPrimaryAppSpecificRoot
method.comment: Returns the primary app-specific external files directory, or an empty string if none is available.

method.name: GetRemovableAppSpecificRoot
method.comment: Returns the first mounted removable app-specific external files directory, or an empty string if none is available.

method.name: GetRemovableVolumeRoot
method.comment: Best-effort helper that derives the removable volume root from Android's app-specific directory path. Always verify write access before using the returned path.

method.name: GetVolumeRootFromAppSpecificDir
method.comment: Best-effort helper that derives a storage volume root from an app-specific external directory path.

method.name: CombinePath
method.comment: Combines a parent path with a child path. The child path cannot contain '..'.

method.name: ResolveRemovableSubDir
method.comment: Combines the removable app-specific root with a child folder path. Returns an empty string if no removable app-specific root is mounted.

method.name: EnsureDirectory
method.comment: Creates the directory if needed. Returns false and raises Error if the directory cannot be created.

method.name: IsDirectoryWritable
method.comment: Verifies direct write access by creating, syncing, and deleting a small temporary file in the directory.

method.name: GetUsableBytes
method.comment: Returns File.getUsableSpace for the directory, or -1 if the directory cannot be checked.

method.name: GetFreeBytes
method.comment: Returns File.getFreeSpace for the directory, or -1 if the directory cannot be checked.

method.name: GetTotalBytes
method.comment: Returns File.getTotalSpace for the directory, or -1 if the directory cannot be checked.

method.name: PickSafFolder
method.comment: Opens Android's folder picker and persists read/write access to the selected SAF tree. The SafFolderSelected event is raised with the selected URI.

method.name: SetSafFolderUri
method.comment: Sets a previously persisted SAF tree URI. Use HasSafFolderPermission to verify the app still has read/write access.

method.name: HasSafFolderPermission
method.comment: Returns true when the current SAF tree URI is still persisted with read and write permission.

method.name: OpenSafDatabase
method.comment: Experimental no-copy SAF mode. Opens or creates DatabaseName in the selected SAF folder, keeps its ParcelFileDescriptor open, and initializes the supplied B4A SQL object through /proc/self/fd. This uses the real .db document on the card, requests MEMORY journal mode, and should not be used with WAL. Local document providers can still vary in sidecar behavior.

method.name: OpenSafDatabaseAtRelativePath
method.comment: Experimental no-copy SAF mode for a database under the selected SAF tree. RelativePath can be a file name such as app.db or a child path such as Databases/app.db. Parent folders are created only when CreateIfNecessary is true. Existing copied databases can be opened with CreateIfNecessary false.

method.name: CloseSafDatabase
method.comment: Closes the supplied B4A SQL object, closes the SAF file descriptor, and releases the SAF manager lock.

method.name: ReleaseSafLockOnly
method.comment: Releases the SAF manager lock without touching a SQL object. Use only for recovery paths where SQL has already been closed or was never opened.

method.name: DeleteSafLockFileIfExists
method.comment: Deletes a stale SAF manager lock document for DatabaseName in the selected SAF folder if this process is not currently holding it.

method.name: DeleteSafLockFileAtRelativePath
method.comment: Deletes a stale SAF manager lock document for RelativePath under the selected SAF tree if this process is not currently holding it.

method.name: IsManageAllFilesGranted
method.comment: Returns Environment.isExternalStorageManager on Android 11+; returns true on older Android versions where this permission does not exist.

method.name: OpenManageAllFilesSettings
method.comment: Opens Android settings so the user can grant Manage All Files access. The ManageAllFilesResult event is raised when the settings activity returns.

method.name: OpenDatabase
method.comment: Acquires a manager lock in Dir and initializes the supplied B4A SQL object directly on Dir/FileName. No local working copy is made.

method.name: OpenDatabaseAtFullPath
method.comment: Same as OpenDatabase, but accepts the complete database path.

method.name: AttachDatabase
method.comment: Locks and attaches a developer-supplied second direct-path SQLite database to the currently managed direct-path SQL connection. SchemaName should be a simple name such as aux.

method.name: AttachDatabaseAtFullPath
method.comment: Same as AttachDatabase, but accepts the complete path to the developer-supplied database to attach.

method.name: DetachDatabase
method.comment: Detaches a schema previously attached through this manager and releases that attached database lock.

method.name: CloseDatabase
method.comment: Optionally checkpoints WAL, closes the supplied B4A SQL object, and releases the main and attached database locks.

method.name: ReleaseLockOnly
method.comment: Releases the manager lock without touching a SQL object. Use this only for recovery paths where SQL has already been closed or was never opened.

method.name: DeleteLockFileIfNotHeld
method.comment: Deletes a stale manager lock file for the database if this process is not currently holding it.

method.name: GetAttachedSchemas
method.comment: Returns the schema names currently attached through this manager.

property.name: LastError
property.comment: Last error message recorded by the manager.

property.name: HasOpenDatabase
property.comment: Returns true while the manager lock is held.

property.name: AttachedDatabaseCount
property.comment: Number of direct-path attached databases currently locked through this manager.

property.name: ManagedDir
property.comment: Directory of the currently managed database, or empty string.

property.name: ManagedFileName
property.comment: File name of the currently managed database, or empty string.

property.name: ManagedPath
property.comment: Full path of the currently managed database, or empty string.

property.name: LockPath
property.comment: Full path of the current manager lock file, or empty string.

property.name: SafFolderUri
property.comment: Current SAF tree URI, or empty string.

property.name: SafDatabaseUri
property.comment: Current SAF database document URI, or empty string.

property.name: SafFdPath
property.comment: /proc/self/fd path used by the current SAF database session, or empty string.

property.name: HasOpenSafDatabase
property.comment: Returns true while a SAF file-descriptor database session is open.
